entities.name: Surgical Bay
entities.description: The fifth sphere of New Phyrexia, dominated by the Progress Engine of Jin-Gitaxias, a toxic quicksilver sea of experimentation.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The layered Phyrexia with nine spheres.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor who repurposed the region as his domain of experimentation.

entities.name: Progress Engine
entities.description: The Phyrexian faction devoted to advancing knowledge and efficiency at any cost.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane whose Quicksilver Sea became the Surgical Bay.

entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: Sea of Mirrodin corrupted by glistening oil.

entities.name: Kraynox
entities.description: Originally envisioned the region as his Fourth Sphere.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who traveled through the Surgical Bay seeking Karn. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Fathom Ward

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias overtakes the region, drains the Quicksilver Sea and converts it into a domain of experimentation, creating the Surgical Bay.
events.quote: Draining the Quicksilver Sea from above, he pooled its contents into this subterranean reservoir and converted it into a domain of experimentation.

events.summary: Searching for Karn, Elspeth, Koth and Venser travel through the Surgical Bay.
events.quote: planeswalkers Elspeth Tirel , Koth , and Venser traveled through the Surgical Bay

relations.note: The bay is the seat of his faction.
relations.quote: Jin-Gitaxias made it the seat of his faction’s anatomical, mechanical, and psychological experimentation
The Surgical Bay is the fifth sphere of New Phyrexia
